verdicts.abstract_excerpt: There are at least two kinds of similarity. Relational similarity is correspondence between relations, in contrast with attributional similarity, which is correspondence between attributes. verdicts.title: Characteristic cohomology of the infinitesimal period relation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The infinitesimal period relation (also known as Griffiths' transversality) is the system of partial differential equations constraining variations of Hodge structure. This paper presents a study of the characteristic cohomology associated with that system of pde.
